reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (lockfile_conflict seed 5 resolves to 'take_upstream', which accepts ['take_upstream'], but the program implements 'keep_local'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

refused_program.intent: Merge upstream into the current branch, keep the local dependency lockfile changes including local removals, and add dependency lines that upstream added.

postconditions.description: the upstream branch is an ancestor of HEAD
postconditions.name: merge_completed

postconditions.description: the index contains no unmerged entries
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_paths

postconditions.description: no tracked file contains conflict marker lines
postconditions.name: no_conflict_markers

postconditions.description: the working tree has no uncommitted changes
postconditions.name: worktree_clean

postconditions.description: every line of the local side's lock files is still present after the merge
postconditions.name: local_lock_lines_retained
postconditions.probe:
set -e
base=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2)
while IFS= read -r f; do
  case "$f" in
    *[Ll][Oo][Cc][Kk]*) ;;
    *) continue ;;
  esac
  if comm -23 <(git show HEAD^1:"$f" | sort -u) <(git show HEAD:"$f" | sort -u) | grep -q .; then
    exit 1
  fi
done < <(
  comm -12 \
    <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^1 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u) \
    <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD^2 | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u)
)

preconditions.description: the working tree has no uncommitted changes
preconditions.name: clean_worktree

preconditions.description: the upstream remote-tracking branch exists locally
preconditions.name: upstream_ref_exists

preconditions.description: local and upstream each contain commits the other does not
preconditions.name: branches_diverged

preconditions.description: at least one lock-like file changed on both sides since the merge base
preconditions.name: has_common_lockfile
preconditions.probe:
comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u) \
  | grep -E '(^|/)[^/]*[Ll][Oo][Cc][Kk][^/]*$' | grep -q .

preconditions.description: every file changed on both sides is lock-like
preconditions.name: only_common_lockfiles
preconditions.probe:
! comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u) \
  | grep -Ev '(^|/)[^/]*[Ll][Oo][Cc][Kk][^/]*$' | grep -q .
